articles.title: What Robinhood’s recent layoffs say about the current state of crypto investments
articles.snippet: Despite the trading platform’s restructuring and the wave of crypto companies making cuts, signaling a late bear market, Altcoin Pro’s Horst, Anderson and Zhuleku explain there’s no reason to panic.

articles.title: Aave, Solana ecosystem tokens lead crypto rebound as bitcoin steadies near $60,000
articles.snippet: Tokenized stock trading fueled fresh momentum across the Solana ecosystem, while Aave founder hinted at token buybacks coming under new framework.

articles.title: Securitize expects to raise $400 million as tokenization firm nears public debut
articles.snippet: The BlackRock-backed tokenization specialist expects to close its SPAC merger next week and start trading on the NYSE, pending shareholder approval.

articles.title: CoinDesk 20 performance update: AAVE jumps 8.9%, leading index higher
articles.snippet: Solana (SOL) gained 4.5%, joining Aave (AAVE) as a top performer.

articles.title: SOL reclaims $72, but onchain data flags weakening momentum
articles.snippet: Solana found strength from tokenized stock trading on its network, but a declining TVL and DEX volumes point to fading momentum.
